comparison.objective: Build a three-layer box crib from crossed pairs with overlapping corners, not adjust machinery damping.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated heavy-block placement, orientation, and stable stacking versus small-tool insertion, counterholding, fine rotation, and bounded tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Three crossed-pair layers with every corner overlapping; body only names the directory and no spec versions or numeric stability rubric are available. Candidate uses dynamic-cycle and drift criteria.
comparison.reason: Structural stacking and overlap geometry test a different ability and outcome.
